# Archival Dispatch: 25 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Mindwebs, Fun at Breakfast, Music Transcription Library, and Indian Trails

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Mindwebs, Michael Hansen, Fritz Leiber, Eric Frank Russell, Fun at Breakfast, Tom Howard, George Shelton, Doris Day, Mel Torme, Ernest Tubb, Red Foley, Indian Trails, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 62 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 62 resolves 25 historical radio broadcasts spanning 1970s speculative fiction audio art, Golden Age morning comedy, Armed Forces Radio Service electrical transcription master discs, and 1930s Native American folklore: 3 classic science fiction readings from WHA Madison's acclaimed ***Mindwebs*** (narrated by Michael Hansen with electronic synthesizer soundscapes, adapting stories by Fritz Leiber, Eric Frank Russell, and L.J. Stecher Jr.), 8 morning comedy routines from NBC's ***Fun at Breakfast*** (starring Tom Howard and George Shelton, 1944), 8 master transcription discs from the ***Music Transcription Library*** (AFRS P-series discs featuring Doris Day, Mel Tormé, Paul Weston, Ernest Tubb & Red Foley, Russ Morgan, Frankie Laine, and Ray Anthony), and 6 folklore episodes from ***Indian Trails*** (syndicated 1937, hosted by The Old Trapper).

---
